item.title: OPEKEPE Fraud Ring Dismantled in Crete: Prominent Agricultural Union Leader Among 15 Arrested
item.description: Greek authorities dismantled a criminal ring in Crete that defrauded OPEKEPE of €1.7 million in EU agricultural subsidies since 2019. Prominent agricultural union leader Myronas Chiletzakis was arrested as the alleged ringleader, alongside an accountant and lawyer couple with reported political ties, amid claims of false land declarations including forested areas and plots of deceased owners. item.title: Greece Offers Up to €10,000 Relocation Aid to Boost Population in Evros Region
item.description: Greece is offering up to €10,000 in financial aid to encourage permanent relocation to depopulated areas in the Evros region, specifically the municipalities of Soufli, Orestiada, and Didymoteicho. The program, active as of 2025, supports single-person and multi-person households with grants paid in two installments to combat demographic decline in this border area.
